notes.note: Scoped follow-up for capture refusal serialization. The push governance lane caught two new direct Error.message egresses. TaskBrowserCaptureError now constructs an explicit public failure response; both capture routes serialize that payload, and BrowserSessionError cases map to fixed public capture messages. The owning repo-governance proof now passes. This delta preserves Task/bound-caller and Project/profile checks, screenshot and storage ownership, all refusal codes and image bytes; the previously reviewed historical/current document status and provider/UI/native qualification limits remain unchanged. No prose change is needed for this error-boundary correction.
